status: generic procedural engineering cockpit; no manufacturer dimensions or sight-picture qualification
author: Flight Simulator contributors
usage: Traceability for original presentation choices; not a runtime aircraft loader or sensed-instrument definition.

dial_bezels.opening: opaque annulus only; no disk, glazing, input or collider

views.default_outside_view: third-person follow; eye and target share the adopted presentation pose
views.instrument_focus: view-only; selection and dismissal while paused; no mapped input suppression

readings_status: Native truth / prototype; TAS, WGS84 ellipsoid height, true heading, kinematic VSI and body yaw are distinct from sensed instruments.
limitations: No source-specific cockpit geometry, GLB export or manufacturer asset is represented.
No IAS, MSL/barometric altitude, magnetic compass, powered instrument, sensor failure or lag is established by this manifest.
Geometry has no aircraft collider or flight-authority role; animated controls copy native-held fractions.
Physical controller walkthrough, pilot review and phase acceptance remain separate.

materials.status: original opaque matte/satin choices; no manufacturer materials

physical_engine_rows.status: copied native EngineStatus; same unit conversion and unavailable labels

texture_allocation_note: 8 MiB calculated RGBA8 color plane only; actual exposed format/dimensions and global rendering counters are qualified separately; exact driver allocation is unobserved.
